intro: Connect, learn, and grow with the ACS Student Chapter at GSTU. Explore chapter activities and apply to become part of our chemistry community.
benefits: Connect with students, faculty, and alumni who share your interest in chemistry.
Hear about chapter workshops, seminars, and outreach activities.
Explore volunteering, knowledge-sharing, and leadership opportunities.
eligibility: Students interested in chemistry and related fields are welcome to contact the chapter. Please confirm the current eligibility criteria with the membership team before applying.
general: General membership details and fees will be published after confirmation by the chapter.
premium: Premium membership benefits, eligibility, and fees will be published after confirmation by the chapter.
renewal: Existing members: contact the chapter with your name, membership ID, and membership year to confirm renewal requirements. Renewal fees and deadlines have not yet been published.
